error[ZBX-E0715]: can't write the archive
  while  exporting the state volume pgdata
  cause  writing the archive to /nowhere/pgdata.tar.gz failed: no such file or
         directory (ENOENT)
  volume pgdata
  file   /nowhere/pgdata.tar.gz
  fix    free space, or write somewhere else with -o <file>

  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0715.html
